name: Johannesburg Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars (backfill; not independently verified): 162 closures (156 with exchange_calendars' names, 6 'Historical Holiday'). exchange_calendars has no early closes for XJSE and misses three declared public holidays. Backfill corrected to JSE's own notices (4c8): 2022-12-27 closed (Market Notice 600/2022), 2023-12-15 closed (Market Notice 386/2023, 'all JSE Markets will be closed'), 2024-05-29 closed (Service Hotline 057/2024); exchange_calendars has all three as trading days. Early closes at 12:00 (equity 'Market Close 12:00') added where a JSE notice was read: 2010-12-24 and 2010-12-31 (notice Y555), 2011-12-23 and 2011-12-30 (notice A1537; 24 and 31 December 2011 were Saturdays, so the early closes moved to the Fridays), 2024-12-24 and 2024-12-31 (Service Hotline 150/2024). The 2012-2023 Dec 24/31 early closes were not read and are absent; 2021-11-01 (Local Government Elections, a declared public holiday) is a trading day in exchange_calendars and in the registry, but no JSE notice was read, so it is marked unconfirmed rather than changed. 2025-2027: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2028-2029: standing pattern. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c8). Last published year: no JSE 2027 calendar was readable (the client-portal calendar and hotline index refuse this sandbox); the 2027 closures follow the Public Holidays Act (Sunday holidays move to Monday). One-off closure: 2026-11-04 was declared a public holiday for the Local Government Elections (https://www.gov.za/news/media-statements/president-cyril-ramaphosa-declares-election-day). JSE closes all markets on declared public holidays (Hotline 130/2025 and 057/2024 say so), so it is added as closed; JSE's own notice for that day was not read, so it is unconfirmed. Early closes: Service Hotline 130/2025 gives the 24 and 31 December 2025 equity schedule (continuous trading to 11:50, closing auction call 11:50-12:00, 'Close of Trading will be at 12:00'), so both are early closes at 12:00 (ADR 0013). 2026-12-24 and 2026-12-31 follow at 12:00, unconfirmed with recheck_date 2026-12-15 until JSE's December 2026 hotline is read; 2027-12-24, 2027-12-31, 2029-12-24 and 2029-12-31 are predicted at 12:00. In 2028 both days fall on a Sunday; the 2011 precedent moved Saturday early closes to the Friday, but no rule for Sundays was read, so 2028 has none. Close (ADR 0013): the JSE's Trading and Information Overview for the Equity Market (Volume 00E, https://www.jse.co.za/sites/default/files/media/documents/2020-02/Volume%2000E%20-%20Trading%20and%20Information%20Overview%20for%20Equity%20Market.pdf) gives the closing auction call 16:50-17:00, and Market Notice 2719 says the earliest close is 17:00:00, with a random uncross up to 17:01:00 (ignored per ADR 0013). regular_hours.close stays 17:00, as one dated entry from 2010-01-01 (unconfirmed: no pre-2013 schedule was read). The post-close sessions (closing price publication 17:00-17:02, closing price cross 17:02-17:10 per the JSE equity factsheet) were not changed.
